label: Custom Conflict Resolver (Sync Gateway)
type: a user-authored JavaScript function, required when a replication's conflict_resolution_type is set to 'custom', resolving a document conflict programmatically instead of via the built-in Sequence-Number/Timestamp XDCR-style enum.
note: Explicitly distinguished from xdcr:conflict-resolution-method in its own extraction notes: Sync Gateway's version is user-authored JS selectable per-replication, XDCR's is a fixed enum chosen at bucket creation - no page states a relationship, kept separate.
